title: Name a range
teach: A named range gives a block of cells a name you can use in formulas. Select the cells and type a name in the Name Box, left of the formula bar.
task: The cells A2:A4 have been named Sales. Which formula adds them using that name?
hints: A name works like a range.
Names are not put in quotes.
SUM is the function that adds.
limit: Gridwise does not let you create names yet, so this lesson is a quick check. In real Excel you name a range in the Name Box.
